assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original portfolio project cover, landscape 3:2. Create one exceptional photorealistic 3D still life about a small online store. Composition: precise asymmetric art direction, bag dominant lower center, headphones upper right, ample clean breathing room around all objects, fully visible silhouettes. Materials: satin bone ceramic, brushed dark metal, thick wine-red optical glass, minute surface texture. Backdrop: seamless warm ivory #f8f6f3 studio cyclorama. Lighting: soft large key light, physically accurate soft contact shadows, one restrained red-neon rim reflection on the plinth, nuanced real reflections. Sophisticated collectible design-object photography, crafted, restrained, elegant, believable 3D depth, cinematic but bright, no generic tech holograms. No text, no letters, no logos, no screens, no extra objects, no watermark. Single full-bleed image, not a collage.
